Logo styles

The styles I design in

Every project starts from your business, your audience and where the logo has to work. These are the directions I work in most.

Geometric marks

Sharp, structured symbols, shown as an app icon — a strong fit for tech, SaaS and startups.

Monograms

Your initials, distilled into one mark, shown on a business card — finance, consulting, personal brands.

Wordmarks

The name itself, set with intent and a supporting lockup line — retail, fashion and consumer brands.

Emblems & badges

Enclosed, stamp-like logos at work on a cup — cafés, food brands and hospitality.

Line marks

Single-weight line work on a product label, light and elegant — beauty, wellness and lifestyle.

Abstract marks

Distinctive shapes carried across a social avatar set — media, creative and modern brands.

About

Lodixo is a one-person design studio built on a simple belief: a small business should look as good as it actually is.

I've spent more than 12 years designing brand identities, and I keep coming back to the same approach — minimal, deliberate marks that stay sharp on a business card, a shop sign and a phone screen alike. No clutter, no trends that expire next year.

When you order, you work directly with me from brief to final files. Every package includes unlimited revisions, because a logo you have to live with for years should be one you're genuinely happy with — and the full vector source files, so the identity is yours to use anywhere, forever.

Beyond logos, I design website interfaces in Figma, so your brand and your website can be built as one consistent system.

Questions

Before you order

How do I order?

All orders run through Fiverr. Pick a package on the branding kit gig, answer the brief questions at checkout, and I'll take it from there. Fiverr holds your payment securely until you approve the delivery.

What files will I receive?

Every package includes the vector source files — AI, EPS, PDF and SVG — plus ready-to-use PNG and JPG versions, and a social media kit. Standard and Premium also include a 3D logo mockup.

What does "unlimited revisions" mean?

Once you've picked a concept direction, I'll keep refining it — colours, typography, spacing, details — until you're happy with the final logo. It's included in all three packages at no extra cost.

How long does delivery take?

Basic and Standard are delivered in 3 days; Premium, with five concepts and the full identity treatment, takes 5 days.

Can you design my website as well?

Yes — my UI/UX gig covers website interface design in Figma, starting from CA$85/project. It's the natural next step once your logo and brand identity are in place. You can find it on my Fiverr profile.

Which package should I choose?

Choose Basic if you already know the style you want. Standard gives you three directions to compare, plus the 3D mockup. Premium is for a full launch — five concepts and the complete identity treatment. Still unsure? Message me on Fiverr first and I'll point you to the right one.
